design_brief_zh: 主卖点是以20寸 Sliver款为主视觉，并用24寸、26寸同色箱体做并排规格对比，帮助用户基于尺寸、重量和容量完成选择；本图只展示已提供的规格事实，不加入价格、单位或未提供的登机适配结论。PC画布2000×2000：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.10,0.38,0.80]，右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]；阅读顺序为标题、选择说明、20寸规格、24寸规格、26寸规格。标题置左上，选择说明紧随其下，三条规格按垂直顺序排列，并以清晰尺寸线分别对应右侧三个箱体；20寸箱体应最大或位于视觉首位，突出61×42×27、重量4、容量42。产品区展示三个Sliver箱体的正面或轻微三分之四角度，拉杆分别调整至不同高度，由成人女性、成人男性和儿童在自然旅行场景中各自旁边或手持不同尺寸，体现比例差异，但不得暗示适用年龄或承重结论。移动端1200×1200：上方场景与三个箱体占[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，底部文案区占[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]；移动阅读顺序保持标题、选择说明、20寸、24寸、26寸，规格文本必须避开轮子和拉杆。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色与自然柔和侧光，银色箱体保留真实聚碳酸酯/ABS外观、竖条纹、铝合金框架、四个防撞角和轮组细节，不夸大材质性能。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线体，标题加粗，数字和尺寸高对比、优先清晰；品牌色#01447B作标题或分隔线，#E5641E仅作小面积强调。三条规格文案必须逐条映射对应箱体。资料未提供重量与容量单位，图片中不得擅自添加kg、L等单位；颜色原始资料写作“Sliver”，应保持该变体标签，避免自行改写为其他颜色名称。
compliance_note_zh: 仅呈现资料中提供的三种Sliver规格、尺寸、重量和容量；重量与容量单位缺失，不补充kg或L。不得把尺寸解读为航空公司登机标准，不使用耐用、轻便或适用所有人群等无法由本图直接证明的绝对表述，不添加认证、测试、承重、静音或官方背书。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photography square composition for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase size-comparison module, with no rendered text, no logos, no labels, no badges, and no watermarks. PC composition: reserve a clean empty text panel on the left 5%–43% width and 10%–90% height; place three matching Sliver hard-shell suitcases on the right 49%–95% width and 8%–92% height. Show the 20-inch suitcase as the visual lead, with 24-inch and 26-inch cases beside it in clearly increasing proportions. Use subtle measurement guide lines and blank callout areas aligned to each suitcase, but do not render numbers or words. Set telescopic handles at visibly different heights and include an adult woman, adult man, and child in a restrained airport or city-travel setting to communicate scale only, without implying suitability, age limits, or performance claims. Use front and slight three-quarter product angles, accurate vertical texture, polycarbonate/ABS shell appearance, aluminium frame, four corner guards, and visible wheels consistent with the supplied product. Low-saturation neutral palette, soft natural side lighting, realistic shadows, clean premium styling, generous negative space, sharp product edges, and accurate proportions. Mobile composition: move the travel scene and three suitcases to the upper 8%–92% width and 5%–58% height, leaving a clear uncluttered lower panel from 5%–95% width and 64%–95% height for later text placement. Keep all text regions empty and ensure the image itself contains no rendered text.
